description: This PHP class, `JsonSerializerDocumentifier`, is part of the SuiteCRM project. It implements a documentifier that converts SugarBean objects into human-readable documents using a BeanJsonSerializer for improved search query handling. The class is designed to produce a simplified, non-module-customizable document representation of beans for indexing purposes.

classes.name: JsonSerializerDocumentifier
classes.description: A documentifier class that serializes SugarBean objects into human-readable documentation form using BeanJsonSerializer.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the serializer instance used for converting beans to arrays.

methods.name: documentify
methods.description: Converts a SugarBean object into an associative array suitable for indexing, applying fixes for phone numbers and emails, and removing the 'id' field.
